literals.u22: Every selected component and both relation endpoints must be jointly visible. Partial or occluded required evidence cannot pass. Sound, temporal history, identity, consent, diagnosis and material chemistry require separate evidence.
literals.u3: One complete optional authored music/band visual proposition, not a genre definition, compulsory styling bundle, real identity, verified musical performance or legal/clinical judgment. Retain every stated actor, count, limb owner, instrument, instrument part, garment layer, hand/string/bow/key/pedal contact, support, cable endpoint, screen region, depicted-image owner and comparison-view boundary in both languages. Keep acoustic instruments and model-specific electronic-pad trigger conditions separate; open rimshot is one rimshot variant, not a definition of every rimshot. Review every source condition and whole-proposition effect against independently frozen requester meaning and dimension/property locks. Roles and research graphs provide no native qualification, owner selection or adoption authority. Do not merge people, transfer a hand or instrument, omit a support endpoint, combine incompatible variants or count a reflected, photographed or displayed person as a new physical actor. All selected distinguishing components and both relation endpoints must be jointly visible; partial or hidden required evidence cannot pass. A still image cannot establish actual sound, timing, groove, repeated motion, chord pitch without tuning/position evidence, successful signal routing, working electronics, crowd consent/safety, biological age, personal identity, sexual orientation, desire, coercion, diagnosis, history, rank, authorship, revenue, rights or material chemistry. Explicit adult fictional performers remain an authored setting, not inferred age or biography of a reference portrait. Sources support bounded terminology/context, not the complete authored scene geometry.
